title: Don Redman, built up by Zutty and finally seen
summary: Marge recalls Zutty praising Don Redman's arranging in Chicago, and meeting him in New York outside the Lafayette, where he turned out to be a small man in knickers and a Panama hat.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Now when they were making these records Zutty would come back and tell you about how great a musician Don Redman was.

Oh yes. And what a gentleman. Oh Zutty just praised him. He was just everything. Oh yes, and he said, Oh Marge and he knows music. He knows how to direct. Oh and he's just so great. I said, what kind of looking man is he? And he says, oh he's a nice looking old brown-skinned fellow. And I said, yes, so I still hadn't met him. This was in Chicago. And I always wanted to meet Don Redman and wanted to listen to those records. Because Zutty would say, Don Redman, you know, he knew how to direct and everything.

And we were in New York, I don't know how long we had been here and I still hadn't met Don Redman. So one Sunday we were out in the afternoon going to the Lafayette or going some place in the afternoon, crossing Seventh Avenue in front of a almost to the Lafayette Theater. And a cab stopped and we were on the side of Lafayette and a little guy got out and Zutty said, there's Don Redman. And I said, where? And he said, there he is, just got out of the cab. And he had on a long pair of knickers.
It was in the Spring time and he had a big Panama hat. And I said, he said, there he is Marge there with the hat on. I said, woooee! (LAUGHTER). That is Don Redman.
Couldn't say any more because Zutty was going to introduce him to me.
Marge was, well the way I'd built him up, Marge thought he was a powerful man you know.
The way he'd arrange this music.
His music, he knew so much music.
But Zutty laughs about that. All I said was woooee! He was such a little fellow. (LAUGHTER). He laughed about that when he got home.
